rule.statement: The respondents failed to satisfy section 39A(2)(d) of the Land Acquisition Act, which requires written consent from the claimants.
rule.supporting_quote: In the absence of any such written document conveying consent, it is my position that the respondents have failed to satisfy section 39A(2)(d) of the Land Acquisition Act.
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: section 39A(2)(d) of the Land Acquisition Act
